beats.say: Apple is building an autonomous AI agent that acts on your behalf. Job listings this week say it will write code, browse the web, control apps and navigate devices.
The market noticed: Meta fell nearly 2% and Anthropic dropped more than 3% after Bloomberg reported Apple's plans.
Apple is late to a crowded field — Anthropic's Duet, OpenAI's Dots and Google's Tasks are already out. It has eyed a launch as soon as the end of next year.

hook: Apple's AI agent news sank Meta and Anthropic
